For quotations of the title "Supreme Head..." I added "in Earth," which is included in the full phrase used in the 1534 Act of Supremacy. This is necessary because citations of the Act omit the phrase without hinting at the omission, which is misleading. "In Earth" was important to Cranmer, who noted that its omission would be heretical; omission arguably implies a meaning that was not intended. Also corrected one citation of the phrase, which said "Of Earth"
